target_customer: Small and mid-size online retailers (Shopify and Magento stores) wanting to personalize the experience for first-time visitors
problem: E-commerce sites know little about a new visitor, so they cannot show relevant products on the first visit. NeoWize used machine learning designed to work with small data sets to personalize from the first visit.
business_model: B2B SaaS plugin for e-commerce platforms

founders.name: Omer Nevo
founders.background_notes: Globes describes him as a veteran of IDF Unit 8200. Education not found. Later VP R&D after the acquisition.

founders.name: Yoav Cafri
prior_employers: IDF Center for Encryption and Information Security (service)
founders.background_notes: Later chief data scientist after the acquisition.

founders.name: Ronen Ness
prior_employers: IDF Center for Encryption and Information Security (service)
founders.background_notes: Listed on the YC page. Globes says he left about 18 months before the 2019 deal.

technical_complexity.rationale: Behavioral machine learning on small data sets for first-visit personalization, delivered as store plugins. Real data science work for a three-person team, though not research-grade.

defensibility.rationale: The algorithm claim was the only stated edge. Plugins for common store platforms were copyable and no data network effect is documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No incumbent is documented as copying it. A customer, beauty retailer Il Makiage, bought it in November 2019 to run its own data science.

market_need_then: E-commerce conversion for new visitors was a known pain, and the company reported revenue gains for client sites in its YC profile. No dated spend figures were found.

rebrands.why: unknown; one unofficial archive page links it to a broader repositioning

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself was found. It was a low-profile B2B plugin vendor.

outcome_analysis: NeoWize built small-data personalization for online stores, raised about $1 million per Globes, and said that was enough to reach profitability. It was acquired by customer Il Makiage in November 2019, with part of the price reportedly tied to future revenue. The founders stayed on as VP R&D and chief data scientist, so the exit looks like a technology and team purchase by a retailer rather than a venture scale outcome.
notes: Company site neowize.com did not resolve in this session. Aggregators (CB Insights, Bouncewatch) show a $120K YC seed in August 2016 and a $740K total elsewhere; these are unverified and conflict with Globes. Globes says deal price depended on revenue reaching $1.5 million. No dated 2016 competitor source was found, so the list is empty. The YC page lists Yoav Cafri as CMO and also notes KitLocate.
